posts.title: Yellow Split Peas
posts.description: We have been growing yellow split peas here in Brittany for several years now. We started with a single row in the vegetable garden, and have gradually increased from there; this year, we have just finished sowing half of one of our small fields (about 300 square metres) with yellow peas. posts.title: Bread Ovens
posts.description: In our part of the world (Brittany, France), outdoor bread ovens were an everyday part of life until well after the second world war.
